catalog.confirmDescription: Use the official catalog publisher included in this version of Portcove, then check for new listings. Game installations continue through their usual review and permission checks.
catalog.description: Get new game listings, artwork and setup information from Portcove’s official publisher.
catalog.reviewAgain: Review official catalog settings again before enabling updates.
catalog.setupIncomplete: Official catalog setup did not complete. Reload settings to review it.
catalog.title: Official catalog updates
catalog.unavailable: Official catalog updates are unavailable in this release.

custom.changes_one: Catalog information will change for {{count, number}} port.
custom.changes_other: Catalog information will change for {{count, number}} ports.
custom.description: Install a signed catalog from a publisher you trust and review each update. This is optional; ordinary catalog changes can arrive with Portcove updates. The built-in catalog remains available offline.
custom.dialogDescription: Choose who can provide your game catalog and review their updates. The built-in catalog remains available offline.
custom.fallbackDetailsLabel: Technical details for catalog fallback {{position}} of {{total}}
custom.fallbackExpired: A saved catalog was expired or had invalid dates. Portcove continued with the available catalog information.
custom.fallbackGeneric: A saved catalog could not be used. Portcove continued with the available catalog information.
custom.fallbackNotLoaded: The selected catalog definition could not be loaded. Portcove continued with the available catalog information.
custom.fallbackReplay: Portcove couldn’t accept this catalog update. Portcove continued with the available catalog information.
custom.fallbackSignature: A saved catalog did not pass signature verification. Portcove continued with the available catalog information.
custom.fallbackUntrusted: A saved catalog was signed by a publisher that is no longer trusted. Portcove continued with the available catalog information.
custom.noGameUpdates: This does not install game updates.
custom.originSignedPrevious: Signed catalog · version {{version}} · using the previous valid update
custom.planDetailsLabel: Technical details for catalog update sequence {{sequence}}
custom.signatureVerified: Signature verified with a trusted publisher key.
custom.title: Custom catalog sources
custom.trustedDescription: Verify the publisher key through a trusted channel. Trust allows that publisher to change release download locations.
custom.trustLocations: Trusting a publisher allows changes to release download locations.

definition.cancelled: Setup check cancelled. Review current setup information before continuing.
definition.description: Check the official catalog for setup options. Checking does not install or replace game files.
definition.ineligible: The offered setup could not be selected. Review the current setup options and requirements.
definition.revoked: The publisher withdrew this setup. Review the current options before continuing.
definition.selected: Setup information checked. Review the current setup options before continuing.
definition.unsupported: The setup check returned an unsupported result. Review current setup information.

listings.description: Refresh port listings, artwork and setup information from the configured official publisher. Game installations keep their existing permissions and files.
listings.title: Game listings
